creative_improvements.idea: Impulse-freshness execution gate for momentum-entry signals (pump-chain+, volume-breakout-long+): at exec time, compare live price to the 5m-local high that triggered the signal. If price already retraced >0.35% from trigger high, the impulse is spent — skip entry. Entry-side fix for the instant-fail cohort, not another exit.
creative_improvements.rationale: 5/8 24h losers died <10min post-entry (CFX 5m, GRASS 6m, ICP 8m, MON 2m, CHIP 5m). Watchdog pattern 2: signals fire post-impulse, execution catches exhaustion tail. RSI cannot separate (instant-fail winners 48-68 vs losers 41-75 overlap completely). The fade was the winning side on CFX/GRASS/ICP — if we can't be on the fade, don't be late to the already-spent pump.
creative_improvements.expected_impact: bounded by instant-fail cohort: 7d ~12 instant-fail losses; if gate blocks 50% with 0 winner loss, ~+$0.30-0.50/7d. Conservative.
creative_improvements.risk: low-medium — MUST backtest winner impact first (self_learner, 1m replay). Cannot verify winner retrace-at-entry without replay. Do NOT ship blind.
creative_improvements.prerequisite: self_learner backtest: for last 30d pump-chain+/vol-breakout winners, what % had already retraced >0.35% from trigger high at exec? If <10%, gate is safe.
